entities.name: Extended APN-AMBR
entities.description: Information element that carries extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate values when standard APN-AMBR IE cannot represent the required values.

entities.name: APN aggregate maximum bit rate
entities.description: Standard APN aggregate maximum bit rate information element defined in clause 9.9.4.2 with maximum value limitations.

entities.name: APN-AMBR values changed by network
entities.description: Condition where at least one of the APN-AMBR values has been modified by the network.

entities.name: APN-AMBR values exceed maximum
entities.description: Condition where at least one APN-AMBR value to be transmitted exceeds the maximum value specified in the standard APN-AMBR IE.

relations.description: Extended APN-AMBR IE inclusion is conditional upon APN-AMBR values being changed by the network.
Extended APN-AMBR IE inclusion is conditional upon APN-AMBR values exceeding the maximum of standard IE.
Extended APN-AMBR IE is defined as an extension to the standard APN-AMBR IE for values beyond its maximum.
